input: Generate a project plan for the AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd. Use the provided project description.
output:
# AI Adoption Project Plan for ABCDE Ltd.

## Objective and Goals
- Reduce delivery delays by 15%
- Lower operational costs by 10%
- Improve service responsiveness

## Scope
The project will focus on integrating AI-powered tools into core business functions, including:
- Demand forecasting
- Route optimization
- Inventory management
- Customer support

## Phase Plan

| Phase                          | Weeks | Dates                     | Key Activities                                          | Milestones / Deliverables                       |
|--------------------------------|-------|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| 1 Project Initiation           | 1-2   | 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-12 | Define project scope; Form cross-functional team; Initial stakeholder meeting | Project charter signed off; Team structure finalized |
| 2 Current State Analysis       | 3-4   | 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-26 | Assess existing processes & systems; Identify data sources & gaps | Current systems audit report; Gap analysis report |
| 3 Use Case Selection           | 5-6   | 2026-04-27 to 2026-05-10 | Shortlist priority AI use cases (forecasting, route optimization) | Final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria |
| 4 Pilot Design                 | 7-10  | 2026-05-11 to 2026-06-07 | Data collection & preparation; Model design and development | Working prototype models; Data pipelines established |
| 5 Pilot Implementation          | 11-14 | 2026-06-08 to 2026-07-05 | Deploy AI models in test environments; Monitor performance | Pilot results report; User feedback and performance metrics |
| 6 Evaluation & Iteration       | 15-16 | 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-19 | Evaluate pilot outcomes; Adjust models as needed | Updated models and process refinements |
| 7 Full Deployment              | 17-22 | 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-30 | Scale AI models across selected departments; Train staff | Full production rollout; Training sessions completed |
| 8 Monitoring & Review          | 23-24 | 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-13 | Continuous performance monitoring; Final project review | Project closure report; Recommendations for future scaling |

## Key Milestones
- Project charter signed off (Week 2)
- Current systems audit report (Week 4)
- Final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria (Week 6)
- Working prototype models (Week 10)
- Pilot results report (Week 14)
- Updated models and process refinements (Week 16)
- Full production rollout (Week 22)
- Project closure report (Week 24)

## Team and Governance
A cross-functional task force comprising:
- Data scientists
- IT professionals
- Business stakeholders

## Assumptions and Open Questions
- Budget details are not provided.
- Named owners for tasks are not specified.
- Success baselines for the goals are not defined.

_Sources: project_description.txt, project_timeline.csv_  
_Draft for PM review — verify before sharing._
